schema.description:
NLU type, used as a filter condition for the source of conversational capabilities. If not specified, all types are selected.  

 * MANAGED: Managed (deprecated)  

 * AUTHORIZED: Authorized; public cloud: Chatbot service  

 * PROVIDED: private; configured in the O&M console with access key (AK), secret key (SK), chatEndpoint, and other parameters  
 * CCC_AUTHORIZED: Xiaomi bot authorized by Cloud Contact Center  

 * CCC_FUNCTION: Alibaba Function Compute service  

 * SSE_FUNCTION: Stream function service, which supports Server-Sent Events (SSE) in Function Compute and is used to integrate third-party LLM-based chatbots  

 * PROMPTS: Integrated with base models such as Qwen  

 * LOCAL: Apsara Stack; local base Xiaomi bot

instance ID  

> When UnionSource is CCC, set UnionInstanceId to the Cloud Contact Center instance ID.
